title: Screen String
description: Adds the ability to create a note on the screen
body:
## ABOUT:
> Screen String - a client utility that adds notes to the screen that you can create.

## Requirements:
> Fabric 1.21.8

## Translations:
> ru (Русский)
> eng (English)

## MORE DETAILS:
1. Adds a new menu to Minecraft where you can enter text for a note in 1 of 10 (for version 1.0.0) slots.
2. Adds an overlay to your notes screen, can be toggled on and off (default by pressing 'J')
